BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The Host header of a remote HTTP request is attacker-controlled.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Setting a forged Host header is enough; no special conditions are needed.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: Password-reset or similar flows are reachable without authentication.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: The victim must click the poisoned link in the received email.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The impact stays within the application account model.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Clicking the link sends a reset token to the attacker, exposing the account.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: A captured reset token lets the attacker take over the account.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
